messages.content: You can call get_weather to answer weather questions.
What's the current weather in Tokyo and is it a good time to walk outside?

message.content:
<think>The user is asking about the current weather in Tokyo and whether it's a good time to walk outside. I should use the get_weather function to get the current weather for Tokyo.
</think>


<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="get_weather">
<parameter name="city">Tokyo</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
